greeting: Hi — I can tell you about Kartik, his experience, or any of his projects: the Player Scout, the Premier League Supercomputer, the Cricket AI Digest and the FPL Auto Manager. What would you like to know?
fallback: I can only help with questions about Kartik Shanbhag and this portfolio — his work, his experience, and the projects shown here. I'm not able to answer that one, but ask me anything about the portfolio and I'll gladly help.

intents.q: Who is Kartik Shanbhag and what does he do?
follow: How can I get in touch?
intents.a: Kartik Shanbhag is a product manager at SI (formerly Sportz Interactive), where he builds real-time sports data products — live auctions and drafts, APIs at broadcast scale, and forecasting models he builds himself. He's based in Mumbai. You can read the full experience or browse what he's built.

intents.q: What are his skills or areas of focus?
follow: How can I get in touch?
intents.a: His work centres on four things: real-time data products, live event operations, APIs at broadcast scale, and forecasting models. The projects are where he proves each of those end to end — built alone, with public code behind every claim.

intents.q: What is his experience and track record?
follow: How can I get in touch?
intents.a: Kartik has been at SI (formerly Sportz Interactive) since 2021. He's shipped for 25 clients and delivered 35+ client projects — for broadcasters, OTT platforms, fantasy operators, technology companies and governing bodies across India and abroad — spanning 12 sports and 15 live auctions and drafts. Three company awards in five years: Value Star – Passion (2025 and 2023) and Rookie of the Year (2022). The experience page has the month-by-month record.

intents.q: Tell me about Player Scout, the football similarity tool.
follow: Tell me about the PL Supercomputer
Tell me about the Cricket AI Digest
How can I get in touch?
intents.a: Player Scout (Python · principal component analysis · GitHub Actions) takes a footballer you already have a view on and finds who else plays like him across five seasons of the big-five leagues, then shows where the two differ — ranking each player against his own position, not the whole pool. Try it · Code.

intents.q: Tell me about the Premier League Supercomputer forecast model.
follow: What is the live data on the home page?
Tell me about the FPL Auto Manager
intents.a: The Premier League Supercomputer (Python · Dixon-Coles · Monte Carlo) predicts the Premier League table, refits itself after every gameweek, and grades its own past predictions against the closing market — 20,000 season simulations per run, and nobody presses anything. It's also what powers the live title-probability bars on the home page. View the live forecast · Code.

intents.q: Tell me about the Cricket AI Digest.
follow: Tell me about the FPL Auto Manager
intents.a: Cricket AI Digest (Node · ESPN Cricket API · Claude · WebSocket) turns one live cricket feed into two briefings from the same match state — the facts behind the moment for an analyst, why it matters for a fan — for about 14¢ an entire T20. View it live · Code. (It's on a free tier that sleeps when idle, so the first load can take a minute to wake.)

intents.q: Tell me about the FPL Auto Manager, the autonomous Fantasy Premier League bot.
follow: Tell me about the PL Supercomputer
Tell me about the Cricket AI Digest
How can I get in touch?
intents.a: FPL Auto Manager (Python · AWS Lambda · linear programming · Claude) rates every player, plans transfers, picks the eleven and the captain, submits them, and publishes its projection before kickoff so it can be marked against a human — unattended, every week. Bot versus human, live · Code.

intents.q: What has he built? An overview of all the projects.
follow: Tell me about the PL Supercomputer
Tell me about the Cricket AI Digest
intents.a:
Four systems, each designed, built and deployed alone, with a live link and public code:
• Player Scout — finds footballers who play like one you name.
• Premier League Supercomputer — forecasts the PL table and refits itself weekly.
• Cricket AI Digest — one live feed, two persona briefings.
• FPL Auto Manager — an autonomous Fantasy Premier League manager.
See them all on the projects page.

intents.q: What is the live data on the home page?
follow: How does the PL Supercomputer work?
How can I get in touch?
intents.a: The bars on the home page are live. They're the current Premier League title probabilities, read straight from Kartik's forecasting model, which rewrites its own output after every round of matches — nothing on it is hand-updated. If the numbers have changed, the model changed them.

intents.q: How can I get in touch or hire him?
intents.a: The best way to reach Kartik is email — kshanbhag231@gmail.com. He's also on LinkedIn and GitHub, and you can download his résumé.

follow: How can I get in touch?
intents.a: This site is five pages of hand-written HTML, one stylesheet and one script — no framework, no build step and no dependencies. The content lives in the HTML so it works even if scripts fail, and the home page pulls live numbers from Kartik's own forecasting model. The source is on GitHub.
